ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.1R Rolling Fuse returns to the validated JS1.1 Lean performance baseline for RimWorld 1.5. The JR1/JR1.1 Regionwise and global Region.Allows experiments are not included. JS1 nearest-order reuse, bucketed per-JobPackage HasJobOnThing memoization, ReachProfile prediction/build logic, WorkPrefilter, haul accelerators and Path shadow policy remain as in JS1.1 Lean. The only behavioral change is ReachProfile long-run safety: the old lifetime cumulative 16-mismatch permanent fuse is replaced inside the existing Reachability prefix/postfix by an 8192-sample rolling soft fuse at 8 mismatches, a 3600-main-thread-frame live Vanilla cooldown, 256 clean forced-shadow probation samples before authority returns, and a 16-mismatch/256-sample emergency hard fuse. No extra Reachability Harmony wrapper, Regionwise cache or global Region.Allows detour is installed.
